# DSH PG Grid
A native DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for browsing and analyzing local PostgreSQL databases without w
epSeek Harness Web plugin for browsing and analyzing local PostgreSQL databases without writing SQL.
DSH 原生 PostgreSQL 数据工作区：通过表格和可视化规则查看、筛选、排序、关联、计算和统计。本插件独立实现，不依赖 VS Code 扩展。

## Features / 功能

- Local loopback PostgreSQL connections, table/schema/view discovery and server-side pagination.
- N

ested AND/OR filters and multi-column sorting over the complete matching dataset.
- Excel-style colu
mn-header menus: ascending/descending sort, searchable paged value choices, include/exclude checkbox
es, conditions and clearing filters. Header filters persist in saved views and apply to exports; NUL
L and empty strings remain distinct. Ordinary and aggregate columns support filters; pivots support

row dimensions.
- Same-database inner/left equality joins, including multi-column join keys.
- Field
-based computed columns: arithmetic, rounding, conditions, null handling, concatenation and date par

ts.
- Grouping and count/sum/average/min/max; pivot tables with totals recomputed from source rows.
- Column width/order/hiding/freezing, range selection, keyboard navigation, clipboard and CSV export

.
- Locally saved analysis views containing rules and column settings, with fresh data on reopen.
-
Visible active-view refresh every 30 seconds, pause/manual refresh, cancellation and stale-response

protection.
- DSH theme integration, opaque sticky headers, visible scrollbars and collapsible analy
DSH theme integration, opaque sticky headers, visible scrollbars and collapsible analysis settings.
Select a table, configure **查询规则**, and click **应用查询规则**. **保存视图** stores the query rules rather tha
n a data snapshot. Column widths are edited in **列设置**. One-to-many joins intentionally retain dupli
. Column widths are edited in **列设置**. One-to-many joins intentionally retain duplicate parent rows.
## Read-only and credentials / 只读与凭据
Queries run in PostgreSQL `READ ONLY` transactions through a restricted, parameterized query compile
r. There is no arbitrary SQL, DML or DDL endpoint. Connections accept only `127.0.0.1`, `localhost`
or `::1`; remote hosts, tunnels and cross-database joins are outside this release.
**记住密码（仅保存在本机）** stores passwords in `$DSH_HOME/pg-grid/credentials.json` (default `~/.dsh/pg-grid/c
redentials.json`) with mode `0600`. Metadata and saved views are separate in `views.json`. Clicking
a saved connection after restarting the plugin reconnects without entering a password. Uncheck the o
ption and connect to remove its saved password. When editing, an empty password field reuses the sav
ed password if remembering remains enabled and connection identity matches.
This is local **plaintext** storage, not an encrypted vault: it does not protect against software ru
nning as your account or root. Do not commit or share these files. Passwords are never returned by t
he API or included in model prompts. Without remembering, credentials last only for the host plugin
included in model prompts. Without remembering, credentials last only for the host plugin lifetime.
## Data semantics and limits
- Filters, joins, aggregations and full exports operate on the whole relation, not just the visible

page.
- Big integers, decimals, JSON and date/time values retain their textual representation. NULL,
empty string and zero are distinct. CSV/clipboard represent NULL as `\N`; CSV quotes empty strings

and escapes multiline content, quotes and spreadsheet formula prefixes.
- Division by zero returns N

ULL with a warning; invalid types produce errors.
- Pages: 25–500 rows; full export: up to 100,000 r
ows. Pivot: up to 100 column values and 100,000 grouping records. Exceeding limits fails explicitly

rather than truncating.
- Up to 20 connections, 8 source tables and 20 computed columns per plan. Co

mputed columns do not reference other computed columns. Query timeout: 15 seconds.
- No source-data
editing, spreadsheet import/writeback, A1 formulas, XLSX compatibility or blank worksheets.
## Optional AI / 可选 AI
The natural-language adapter is implemented but **disabled by default** (`aiEnabled: false` in `cord
is.patch.yml`). Ordinary browsing, refresh, export and saved views never call a model.
The AI panel lists models configured in DSH settings. If explicitly enabled, an explicit choice rout
es the request to that provider/model; otherwise it follows the current session selection or the DSH
default. Explicit selections are checked against the available model directory before dispatch. Onl
y selected table schemas, the current rules, the request, and optionally up to 20 current-page rows
are sent to that provider. Model output must pass the same closed query compiler and selected-table
scope checks as manual rules. Offline tests cover routing, unavailable-model rejection and metadata
isolation. Three bounded GLM-5.3-Flash calls on the configured DSH Coding Plan route validated filte
ring, multi-column sorting and a same-database inner join against complete independent read-only SQL
results. This does not validate other providers or establish actual billed cost. Enabling AI can co
nsume provider quota or incur charges.
